meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 通过腾讯 iLink Bot API 接入个人微信：手机扫码登录后，Claude 能接收并回复微信私聊和群消息，消息用长轮询实时到达。不需要公网 webhook 地址，也不用付费 token。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入个人微信渠道，或提到 iLink Bot、微信扫码登录等时触发；正文流程从复制适配器、装依赖开始。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制微信适配器、装依赖，并打印二维码链接

say.text: 微信登录失效了，帮我重新扫码
say.note: 删除 auth.json 并重启，重新给出二维码

say.text: 把这个微信联系人接到我的 agent

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel via Tencent's iLink Bot API: after QR scan login, Claude sends and receives WeChat DMs and group messages over long-polling, with no webhook URL or paid token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw, or mention iLink Bot or QR scan login.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat as a channel in NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the client, prints a QR URL

say_en.text: My WeChat session expired, re-login for me
say_en.note: Deletes auth.json, restarts, asks for a new QR scan

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat contact to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs the wire-dm helper to link this conversation
